symbols.>: RARE should be better on the endpoint after the premise and parity contract are sealed
symbols.=: pre-registered equivalence/non-inferiority relation; not merely non-significance
symbols.<: RARE should be worse on the endpoint in this negative regime
symbols.?: two-sided or not identifiable before data; no superiority claim
symbols.N/A: arm or endpoint is not qualified; preserve NO-GO reason

endpoints.H1: common held-out cohort Brier/log loss; lower is better
endpoints.H2: independent future-assignment quality-cost utility U=Y-lambda*C; higher is better
endpoints.H3: full publish/read/update p95, backlog, drops/timeouts under fixed envelope; lower is better
endpoints.H4a: false producer-attribution rate with independent owner truth; lower is better
endpoints.H4b: coverage, abstention, UNKNOWN and owner-truth recall, reported alongside H4a

direction_rows.premise: development/exogenous validation shows version-correct J plus typed ownership/version features add signal beyond trace, count, terminal and the frozen same-information contextual/task ridge; heterogeneous peers; sufficient legal selected labels
direction_rows.falsifier: J permutation/masking, trace-only, or matched composition reproduces the H1/H2 gain; or H2 gain disappears after complete cost and common-cohort evaluation
direction_rows.claim: Only if H1, H2 and H4a pass their separate gates and H3 stays within its service envelope may this support mechanism-specific superiority

direction_rows.premise: public execution facts already explain the defect and J is redundant or occasionally wrong, as in the C1 diagnostic pattern
direction_rows.falsifier: RARE improves after J is permuted or trace is held fixed, or it gains only by receiving extra public fields
direction_rows.claim: At most trace/evidence compatibility; no J-specific superiority

direction_rows.premise: development stream establishes repeatable task-peer crossover, adequate local support and legal feedback transfer across an untouched root/time holdout
direction_rows.falsifier: gain vanishes on root/time holdout, is explained by ridge, or local support is below the frozen positivity threshold
direction_rows.claim: Task-peer matching value only; no general online superiority without the strong-control contrast

direction_rows.premise: J is constant/uninformative or the policy is at cold start, while all arms pay matched opportunity and service costs
direction_rows.falsifier: a J-specific gain survives permutation/masking without a predeclared alternative signal; inspect leakage or unequal capacity
direction_rows.claim: No positive role-learning claim; extra cost should count against RARE

direction_rows.premise: version swap, stale evidence or semantic replacement is introduced ex ante and a version-aware/reset control receives the same legal read cut
direction_rows.falsifier: version-isolated state still changes the wrong peer/version, or RARE wins only because the control lacks the same version field
direction_rows.claim: Negative-transfer boundary; version safety may improve attribution while slowing recovery

direction_rows.premise: local history is sparse or task semantics shift, with insufficient overlap for a personalized estimate
direction_rows.falsifier: apparent gain is confined to repeated templates or disappears after semantic/root holdout; report wide intervals and UNKNOWN
direction_rows.claim: Pooling or abstention may be preferable; no universal local-personalization claim

direction_rows.premise: arrival rate or evidence cost is high under a predeclared fixed service/token/queue envelope
direction_rows.falsifier: reported benefit uses core update time while omitting publish/read/queue/token/retry cost, or drops are silently removed
direction_rows.claim: A quality gain with net utility or service regression is a trade-off, not superiority

direction_rows.premise: drift schedule and delayed but legal labels are sealed before confirmation; labels arrive often enough for an update comparison
direction_rows.falsifier: frozen or matched updater recovers equally fast, or RARE's gain is due to more labels/capacity
direction_rows.claim: Report recovery and old-root forgetting separately; no updater-speed claim before a frozen implementation card

endpoint_gates.H1: paired common-cohort Delta Brier/log-loss and predeclared MDE/non-inferiority margin; policy-specific selected-only populations are not comparable
endpoint_gates.H2: paired future Delta U with known independent Y, all-attempt ITT denominator, UNKNOWN worst-case bound and frozen lambda/cost cap
endpoint_gates.H3: non-inferiority envelope for publish/read/update p95, backlog and drops/timeouts under fixed arrivals and resource budget
endpoint_gates.H4a: owner-truth false-attribution margin with producer/recipient/sink/mixed/resource strata
endpoint_gates.H4b: coverage, abstention, UNKNOWN and owner-truth recall are reported separately; abstention cannot pass H4a

closure.scientific_gate: OPEN until v4 B1-B7 receipt is complete
